title: Brewery Plus
description: BreweryPlus is an plugin for BreweryX that adds a recipe book, locked and unlockable recipes, recipe papers, and a semi-finished ingredients menu. It also includes recipe progression, player levels, multilingual support and configurable settings for Paper
body:
`BreweryPlus` is an plugin for `BreweryX` for Paper servers that expands the brewing experience with a full recipe progression system.

The plugin adds a personal recipe book for each player, unlockable and locked recipes, recipe papers, semi-finished ingredients menus, and a recipe level system based on discovered drinks. Players can browse their unlocked recipes, learn new ones through special papers, track their progress, and interact with BreweryX recipes in a more structured and immersive way.

Main features:
- personal recipe book for every player
- locked and unlockable BreweryX recipes
- recipe papers that can be given or crafted
- semi-finished ingredients menu
- recipe progression and level system
- separate progress menu
- configurable globally unlocked recipes
- multilingual support
- configurable GUI and messages
- Paper 1.21 support

This project is designed to work directly with `BreweryX` and stores recipe progress inside the plugin itself, so no external recipe-management plugin is required.

If you find bugs or have ideas for improvements, feedback is always welcome.
